priorities.summary: Out-of-bounds write in the kernel's libceph code (bucket_perm_choose()), remotely triggerable with no privileges, affecting kernels up to 6.12.108/6.18.49/7.2.3.
Arbitrary file upload in the 10Web Booster WordPress plugin (≤2.34.10) lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files and achieve remote code execution via a leaked REST nonce.
Stored XSS in Crafty Controller (≤4.10.8): unauthenticated attackers inject malicious content into server activity logs via spoofed X-Forwarded-For headers, executing in the admin's browser.

model.name: Meta Muse Spark Open
model.summary: Meta open-weighted its flagship Muse Spark model (816B total params, 42B active per token, 1M context) for coding and long-running agentic work — claiming the most capable U.S. open-weight model to date — under the Muse Model License with limited commercial terms.
